text:
maya_ng: quick follow-up from the KV OOMs overnight — capturing owners and short ETAs. please acknowledge.

igor_petrov: ack. which shards were repeat offenders?

sophie_leaf: b3 and d2 repeated; a1 was a single spike during retries. pprof indicates survivor growth in medium slab bins (512-2k).

liam_k: eviction thresholds never crossed because residency sat around 76-80%. concurrent minor GCs clustered and then triggered full GC.

maya_ng: actions:
- heap dumps + survivor histo (sophie_leaf) 10/03 ETA Thu
- soft shard guardrail canary (igor_petrov) 12/03 ETA Wed
- eviction/compaction experiments (liam_k) 16/03 ETA Mon
- recurrence analysis (maya_ng) 11/03 ETA Tue

igor_petrov: plan for soft guardrail: 85% residency soft limit, 5% hysteresis, reject non-critical writes first, canary on b3 then d2. will add Retry-After header.

sophie_leaf: repro for staging: `./kv-churn --shard b3 --rate 5k --dur 10m` then `curl staging-b3:6060/debug/pprof/heap` 10/03 I'll upload summaries.

liam_k: testing matrix: max_live_fraction [0.6,0.5], compact_interval [30s,120s]. will report CPU and p99 impact.

eng-oncall: scheduled 30m review Fri 08:30 PT to sign off on canary thresholds. calendar invite sent.

maya_ng: please include rollback steps and a kill-switch metric. i'll update the postmortem doc and mark owners. thanks.
